name: Garmin
author: n1byn1kt
description: Your Garmin day in the bar: a configurable metric chip (Body Battery, steps, sleep, or readiness) and a panel of customizable cards — day curve, sleep, steps, readiness, HRV, activities, opt-in weight, and more. Try it demo-mode first, no account needed.

barWidget.description: Health chip — Body Battery, steps, sleep or readiness; click for the full panel

schema.label: Bar metric
schema.description: Shown on the bar chip. The panel's edit mode overrides this.

schema.label: Show steps next to the bar metric
schema.description: Ignored when the bar metric is steps.

schema.label: Step goal if Garmin doesn't provide one
Panel cards (comma-separated, in order)
schema.description: Any of: curve, battery, sleep, steps, readiness, rhr, hrv, intensity, floors, calories, weight, activity, custom. Order matters, so this stays a list rather than a multiselect. The panel's edit mode overrides this.

schema.label: Command for the 'custom' card
schema.description: Must print one JSON object: {title, value, caption, meter:{value,max}, tone}. Runs as you, 9s timeout, 8KB output cap.

schema.label: Demo mode
schema.description: Synthetic data, no account, no network. Clearly marked. For trying the widget and for screenshots.
